title: AlphaFold-guided phylogenetic analyses suggest surprising heterogeneity in metazoan replication origin licensing mechanisms.
one_liner_zh: 利用AlphaFold结构预测进行系统发育分析，研究后生动物DNA复制起始许可机制中ORC6缺失与ORC3-MCM互作的演化保守性，属于蛋白质-DNA复制起始复合物互作的结构建模研究，但非典型TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移至蛋白-核酸互作建模。
abstract: DNA replication initiation is a tightly regulated process that requires the coordinated assembly of replication machineries throughout the genome. During the first step of initiation, origin licensing, the MCM replicative helicase motor is loaded onto replication origins by the origin recognition complex (ORC) as a head-to-head double hexamer complex. Distinct mechanisms have been proposed to facilitate human MCM double hexamer loading, but the physiological relevance of each of them remains unclear. Here, we investigate the evolutionary conservation of these pathways using an AlphaFold-guided structural phylogenetics approach. Our analyses reveal that ORC6, a subunit of ORC previously thought to be essential for origin licensing in vivo, has been lost in multiple metazoan lineages. Despite this loss, many of these species retain an element in ORC3, the ORC3 tether, that can interact with MCM and facilitate an ORC6-independent MCM loading mechanism. AlphaFold2 Multimer predictions suggest that ORC3 tether interactions with MCM are broadly conserved across Metazoa. Our findings support the physiological relevance of ORC6-independent MCM loading, provide experimentally testable hypotheses on origin licensing mechanisms in diverse metazoan species, and highlight how AlphaFold can be leveraged to investigate protein evolution and function over large timescales.
abstract_zh: DNA复制起始是一个受到严格调控的过程，需要在整个基因组中协调组装复制机器。在起始的第一步，即起源许可（origin licensing）中，MCM复制解旋酶马达通过起源识别复合物（origin recognition complex, ORC）以头对头双六聚体复合物的形式装载到复制起点上。已有多种机制被提出以促进人类MCM双六聚体的装载，但每种机制的生理相关性仍不清楚。在此，我们利用AlphaFold引导的结构系统发育学方法研究这些途径的进化保守性。我们的分析揭示，ORC6，即ORC的一个亚基，先前被认为在体内起源许可中至关重要，但在多个后生动物谱系中已丢失。尽管存在这种丢失，许多这些物种在ORC3中保留了一个元件，即ORC3系链（ORC3 tether），它能与MCM相互作用并促进不依赖ORC6的MCM装载机制。AlphaFold2 Multimer预测表明，ORC3系链与MCM的相互作用在后生动物中广泛保守。我们的发现支持不依赖ORC6的MCM装载的生理相关性，为不同后生动物物种中的起源许可机制提供了可实验验证的假设，并强调了AlphaFold如何被用于在长时间尺度上研究蛋白质进化与功能。
